privacyPolicy.intro: We are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our Netzr mobile application.
privacyPolicy.dataCollectedContent:
We collect the following types of personal data:

• Personal Information: Name, surname, email address, phone number
• Account Data: Login credentials, user preferences
• Energy Data: Solar production, battery status, grid import/export data, energy consumption patterns
• Device Telemetry: Inverter status, device serial numbers, firmware versions, real-time power metrics
• Location Data: Home address, device installation location (for accurate energy monitoring)
• Camera Data: We access your device camera solely to scan QR codes for device registration. No images or video are captured, stored, or transmitted.
• Usage Data: App usage patterns, feature interactions, error logs
privacyPolicy.purposeContent:
We process your data for the following purposes:

• To provide and maintain the Netzr energy management service
• To monitor and optimize your energy production and consumption
• To send notifications about system status, alerts, and updates
• To improve our services and develop new features
• To comply with legal obligations
• To communicate with you regarding your account and support requests
privacyPolicy.legalBasisContent:
We process your personal data based on:

• Your consent when you create an account and accept these terms
• Performance of a contract (providing our services to you)
• Legal obligations (GDPR - General Data Protection Regulation)
• Legitimate interests (improving our services, preventing fraud)
privacyPolicy.thirdPartyContent:
We may share your data with:

• Cloud Service Providers: For secure data storage and processing
• Analytics Providers: To improve app performance (anonymized data)
• Energy Grid Operators: When required for grid integration
• Government Authorities: When required by law

We never sell your personal data to third parties.
privacyPolicy.dataRetentionContent:
We retain your personal data for:

• Account data: As long as your account is active, plus 2 years after deletion
• Energy data: 5 years for historical analysis and reporting
• Device telemetry: 2 years for service improvement
• Usage logs: 1 year for troubleshooting

You may request earlier deletion by contacting us.
privacyPolicy.userRightsContent:
Under GDPR, you have the right to:

• Access: Request a copy of your personal data
• Rectification: Correct inaccurate or incomplete data
• Erasure: Request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten")
• Portability: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
• Objection: Object to processing based on legitimate interests
• Restriction: Request limitation of processing
• Withdraw Consent: Withdraw your consent at any time

To exercise these rights, please contact us through the app.
privacyPolicy.securityContent:
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including:

• Encryption in transit and at rest
• Secure authentication mechanisms
• Regular security audits
• Access controls and monitoring
privacyPolicy.contactContent: For privacy-related inquiries, please contact us through the app's support feature or settings menu.
privacyPolicy.changesContent: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy in the app and updating the "Last Updated" date.
privacyPolicy.devicePermissionsContent:
Our app requires certain device permissions to function properly:

• Camera: Used exclusively to scan QR codes for registering energy devices (inverters, batteries). We do not capture, store, or transmit any photos or videos. Camera access is only active during the QR scanning process.

• Location: Used to determine your home location for accurate energy monitoring, time zone settings, and regional energy data.

• Notifications: Used to send alerts about energy production, battery status, system warnings, and important updates.

You can manage these permissions at any time through your device settings.

termsOfService.intro: Welcome to Netzr. By using our mobile application, you agree to these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully.
termsOfService.serviceDescriptionContent:
Netzr is an energy management application that allows you to:

• Monitor solar energy production and consumption
• Track battery status and grid interactions
• Receive real-time alerts and notifications
• Control inverter modes and settings
• View historical energy data and analytics
• Share device access with other users
termsOfService.userAccountContent:
To use our services, you must:

• Create an account with accurate information
• Keep your login credentials confidential
• Be at least 18 years old or have parental consent
• Notify us immediately of any unauthorized access

You are responsible for all activities under your account.
termsOfService.userResponsibilitiesContent:
You agree to:

• Use the service only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to gain unauthorized access to any systems
• Not interfere with or disrupt the service
• Not reverse engineer or copy the application
• Maintain accurate account information
• Comply with all applicable laws and regulations
termsOfService.intellectualPropertyContent:
All content, features, and functionality of the Netzr app are protected by intellectual property laws. This includes:

• Software code and algorithms
• User interface design
• Trademarks and logos
• Documentation and content

You may not copy, modify, or distribute any part of the service without written permission.
termsOfService.serviceAvailabilityContent:
We strive to maintain continuous service, but we do not guarantee:

• Uninterrupted or error-free operation
• Compatibility with all devices
• Accuracy of energy calculations
• Real-time data in all circumstances

We may suspend service for maintenance or updates with prior notice when possible.
termsOfService.liabilityContent:
To the maximum extent permitted by law:

• The service is provided "as is" without warranties
• We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages
• Our total liability is limited to the amount paid for the service
• We are not responsible for third-party device malfunctions
• We are not liable for energy loss or damage from service interruptions
termsOfService.terminationContent:
Either party may terminate this agreement:

• You may delete your account at any time through the app
• We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms
• Upon termination, your access will be revoked
• Data will be handled according to our Privacy Policy and applicable laws
termsOfService.governingLawContent:
These Terms are governed by the laws of The Netherlands. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

For EU users, nothing in these terms affects your statutory rights under EU consumer protection laws.
termsOfService.changesContent: We may modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance. We will notify you of significant changes through the app or email.
termsOfService.contactContent: For questions about these Terms, please contact us through the app's support feature or settings menu.
